system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Supports inter-node variables (`{agent1Output}`), date/time variables, and custom
variables defined directly in the workflow JSON, with optional Jinja2 templating for advanced logic.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are authored per workflow node with variable substitution; no line numbers available in evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Not a repository-agent; conversation context/memory retrieval rather than environment knowledge. Node registry source not in bundle.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: a continuously updated "rolling summary" of the entire chat
context_compaction.note: ContextCompactor node also exists (context_compactor_handler.py); only config-reachable via workflow nodes.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
its output is saved as
a variable for subsequent nodes
observation_format.note: Image handling exists for inputs; observation conversion code not in bundle.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Full OpenAI-style tool calling passthrough, including reliable multi-round tool loops through authored-prompt
workflows (`appendNativeToolExchange`).
tool_call_format.note: MCP scripts may parse tool calls from text; parser code not in bundle.

tool_count.note: Tools are passthrough from client or workflow-defined; no default tool list in evidence.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool registry visible in bundle.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
connects to an MCP server defined under Public/Configs/MCPServers/ (user-configured) over
stdio (local process), SSE, or streamable HTTP, for MCPToolCall nodes
tool_schema_source.note: Client-supplied OpenAI tool schemas passed through; other sources not determinable.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: mcp 1.28.1 - Model Context Protocol client (MCPToolCall node)

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
workflows, which are
JSON files that define a sequence of steps (nodes)
loop_primitives.note: Conditional routing within workflows; multi-round tool loops possible via passthrough.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Instead of relying on unreliable autonomous agents, Wilmer became focused on semi-autonomous Workflows
planning_granularity.note: Plan encoded in user-authored workflow JSON, not a model-maintained plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each node in a workflow can connect to a completely different LLM endpoint or execute a tool.
multi_agent_topology.note: Multi-LLM workflow nodes; closest value pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The route chosen kicks off another specialized workflow, which can call more workflows from there.
delegation_mechanism.note: Routing hands control to sub-workflows; closest value.

human_in_loop.note: No config schema for approval in bundle.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
This data structure encapsulates all runtime
information for a single operational step, including the full conversation history, the current node's configuration, and
outputs from previous nodes.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
a chronological summary file, a continuously updated "rolling summary" of the entire chat, a searchable
vector database (keyword search by default, with optional embedding-based semantic/hybrid search)
long_term_memory.note: Vector DB is SQLite FTS5 keyword by default; embeddings optional.

self_verification.note: Iterative follow-up review steps can be authored in workflows but not harness-enforced by default.

retry_policy.note: test_llm_api_failover.py suggests endpoint failover (transport), not task retry.

termination_condition.note: Workflow ends after final node; early_termination_exception.py exists; loop code not in bundle.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
using a small, fast local model for summarization
and a large cloud model for the final reasoning, all within a single workflow.
cost_controls.note: README states no token usage tracking.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
PythonModule workflow nodes execute user-provided Python scripts from the configured scripts
directory with the full privileges of the Wilmer process. These scripts are not sandboxed or
validated by Wilmer.
execution_isolation.note: CurlCommand spawns subprocess; MCP stdio servers as local processes.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: with the full privileges of the Wilmer process

network_policy.evidence_quote:
The WebFetch and
CurlCommand nodes additionally support an opt-in SSRF guard (blockPrivateAddresses / allowedHosts)

permission_model.evidence_quote:
These scripts are not sandboxed or
validated by Wilmer.
permission_model.note: Actions are authored workflow nodes; allowedHosts opt-in.

tracing.evidence_quote: At DEBUG level, logs may contain full prompts and LLM responses

guardrails.evidence_quote: all log statements that could contain user content are automatically redacted.
guardrails.note: Redaction applies to logs; action_policies via opt-in SSRF guard (allowedHosts).

target_domain.evidence_quote: WilmerAI is an application designed for advanced semantic prompt routing and complex task orchestration.

open_source.evidence_quote: the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It connects to various LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, KoboldCpp)

first_release_date.note: README says kicked off late 2023; no tag date given.
